_comment2: minMediaDemo = the number of preview images this screen must actually PAINT once bin/demo-seed.php has run. Asserted only under VISUAL_DEMO=1, because only then is the dataset known. It exists because every other check here can only fail on an element the page asked for: a screen that stops emitting posters altogether has nothing to break, so '0 console errors, 0 broken images' stayed green over empty tiles. The numbers are what the seeded dataset actually renders today (library 10 clips, queue 6 approval cards, dashboard 4 cards + 1 sample account frame, plan 4 filled days) — a floor, not an equality, so adding content never fails the gate. TWO LIMITS, stated so nobody reads more into a green run than it earned: (1) it asserts QUANTITY, not content — a poster of a flat gradient decodes fine and would pass, so what actually keeps the previews photographic is the committed real-stock fixture, not this number; (2) it is a page-level sum, so it cannot tell four painted account frames from four painted approval posters, and a screen with no floor declared is not checked at all — the four run-detail routes render zero preview images today and are therefore unguarded here.
_comment: Phase 15.9 visual-test screen inventory. shot.mjs renders each page at every width x locale. 'auth' false = reachable without login (skipped during the authenticated pass). Detail routes mostly stay out — they need a stable seeded id. The exceptions are /runs/2 and /runs/3, added in Phase 25 because the post-text editor lives there and on /queue, and a screen nobody photographs is a screen nobody checks: run 2 is still editable, run 3 has finished so it shows the read-only state, and run 4 was edited by a person so it carries the edit chip and the compliance chip derived from that edit. bin/visual-seed.php creates all three deterministically.

screens.name: run-detail-demo-published
screens._why: FIXTURE-DB ONLY. Run id 5 is the showcase run in the ISOLATED visual database; pointed at a real workspace this same path lands on whatever run happens to be #5 there — in ws2 that is a cancelled June run whose draft render is flat mock-stock colour, which reads as a broken tile in a capture even though the frame is honest. When screenshotting a real workspace, resolve the run id from the database first. The showcase seed's own finished+published run. Without it the gate photographs only visual-seed fixtures, so what the demo seed writes on a published run has no visual coverage. 'demo': true = only captured when VISUAL_DEMO=1 seeded it; otherwise this id does not exist and would 404.
